item.title: [News] Huawei Unveils 7.2Tbps Near-packaged Optics Module, Challenging NVIDIA and Broadcom’s CPO Push
item.description: As NVIDIA, Broadcom and TSMC rally behind co-packaged optics (CPO), Huawei is charting a different course with near-packaged optics (NPO). According to Nikkei and the South China Morning Post, the Chinese tech giant unveiled its own NPO standard and debuted a 7.2Tbps solution on Thursday at the China International Optoelectronic Exposition (CIOE). item.title: 国际海缆韧性咨询机构召开全体会议
item.description: 2026年7月10日，国际电信联盟国际海缆韧性咨询机构首届任期收官会议在瑞士日内瓦召开。该机构是国际电信联盟推动全球海缆治理体系建设的重要机制，下设海缆快速部署与维修风险监测与缓解地理路由多样性三个工作组，旨在凝聚各界力量，研究海缆建设与保护中的重大问题，推动形成国际共识和政策建议。
